recipe.visualDefinition: A black-and-white split-screen composition featuring two vintage childhood photographs of young boys side-by-side, overlaid with high-contrast, distressed white typography at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Parallel subjects representing a shared history or partnership
Contrast between clean geometric sans-serif and raw distressed lettering
Unified monochromatic tone bridging two disparate source images
Bottom-weighted typographic hierarchy anchoring the visual weight
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white color profile
Visible film grain and vintage photo artifacts
Split vertical composition with a soft or hard center seam
Distressed, hand-painted texture on the primary title text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects of roughly equal scale positioned in the left and right halves of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, textured title text at the bottom center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the left subject, move to the right subject, then drop down to the clean subtitle and finally the large title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Darker areas in the background of the photos provide contrast for the white text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark grays in the photographic backgrounds.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for all typographic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin tones and environmental details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the subjects/text and the shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and heavy brush script
letterConstructionRules: Subtitle uses wide tracking and uniform stroke weight
Main title uses irregular, jagged edges mimicking dry-brush paint
High verticality in the main title glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title feature internal 'scratched' textures and eroded terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a clean, modern sans-serif and a raw, organic textured display face.

preserve: Wide tracking of the top line
Distressed texture of the bottom line
avoid: Clean, vector-perfect edges on the main title

candidateDirections.reason: For the wide-tracked subtitle to maintain a modern, clean look.
For the main title to capture the aggressive, dry-brush texture.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a black and white composite of two vintage 1980s childhood photos. Left side: a toddler in a cowboy hat and boots. Right side: a toddler on a plastic tricycle. Apply heavy film grain and high contrast.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of white text at the bottom. Top line: clean geometric sans-serif in all caps with extreme letter spacing. Bottom line: large, distressed brush-style lettering with a hand-painted texture.

verificationChecks: Is the subtitle tracking significantly wider than the title tracking?
Does the main title have a visible 'eroded' or 'dry-brush' texture?
Are there two distinct photographic subjects?

adjustableVariables: Width of the tracking on the subtitle
Level of erosion on the display font
mustRedesign: Any brand logos on clothing or toys
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not obscure the faces of the subjects.
Ensure the black levels are deep enough to make white text pop.
Verify that the two photos feel like they belong to the same era.
Confirm the distressed text looks like paint, not a digital glitch.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [two vintage childhood photos] + [grayscale filter] + [wide-tracked sans-serif subtitle] + [large distressed brush-script title] = Nostalgic Country Aesthetic.
